zh-CN.title: 高级聊天记录管理
items: 搜索记录右上角可进入全屏管理，按日期、类型和关键词筛选，支持多列浏览与框选
固定重要记录后批量清理其余消息，删除仅影响自己，系统消息也可管理

en.title: Advanced chat history management
items: Open a fullscreen manager from chat search with date, type and keyword filters, multiple columns and drag selection
Keep important records protected during batch cleanup; deletion affects only you and includes system messages
